name: Almodad
overview: Almodad is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Joktan. Beyond this familial connection, the biblical record provides limited information about him. His mention is brief and serves primarily genealogical purposes within the broader biblical narrative.
namesAndTitles: The name Almodad means 'G-d [El] is loved,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that acknowledges God's belovedness. This proper name is recorded in Genesis 10:26 and was not given directly by God but carries significant spiritual implication.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Almodad as a son of Joktan, establishing his place within a specific lineage. No additional family relationships or descendants are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Almodad's significance lies in his role as part of the genealogical record tracing the descendants of Joktan. This genealogy contributes to the biblical understanding of the spread of nations and peoples after the Flood. His mention underscores the providential unfolding of God's plan through successive generations.
